title: RDW-gated neutrophil/lymphocyte coupling does not establish added CRP prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: Existing-data incremental prediction study: source NHANES2007-08 n4839 and separate target2009-10 n5223. Fixed anisocytosis-gated logNLR feature versus flexible routine CBC and demographic measures. MSE reduction0.00030663 (0.0278%), joint source-refit/target PSU bootstrap95%CI[-0.01055697,0.00221192]. No established predictive gain; sensitivity includes knot instability. Same-program historically reused samples, not pristine independent-program confirmation. Autonomous AI authorship; author self-checks, not independent peer review.
